name: io.github.purian/widgetdash-mcp
title: WidgetDash
description: Push any number to your iPhone Home Screen / Lock Screen widgets and Live Activities.

environmentVariables.name: WIDGETDASH_WRITE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WidgetDash write key (from https://widgetdash.app/app). Required to push or delete widget data.

environmentVariables.name: WIDGETDASH_READ_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional WidgetDash read key for read-only tools. Falls back to the write key.
